hypothesis: Direct best-response packing over a library of individually valid scope-111 Golomb rulers can escape the depth-five exact-cover ceiling because row swaps optimize the global union of differences without perturbing rows into locally invalid states.
rationale: Coordinate annealing repeatedly remained near 100 unique differences, while exact-cover branching on sampled catalogs reached depths four to five. A row-library state is always locally valid; replacing one row at a time gives a different search neighborhood over the compatibility graph and directly optimizes the true global distinct-difference count.
expected_information_gain: Tests whether the obstruction is the coordinate representation/repair path rather than the availability of compatible row masks, using exact bitmask union as the packing objective.
method: Generate up to 100,000 deduplicated valid six-mark Golomb rulers with scope<=111 from uniform mark samples. Initialize seven-row states greedily from the library, then perform randomized best-response row swaps: for each selected row, sample library candidates and candidates indexed by currently uncovered differences, retaining the replacement with maximum exact union cardinality and accepting occasional one-unit regressions at fixed temperature 0.25. Restart after 700 stagnant iterations. Independently validate the best seven-row state with the integer DTS verifier.
metric: library cardinality, exact seven-row union unique-difference count, packing iterations, restarts, target assignment, and independent DTS validity
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A validator-valid seven-row state with 105 unique differences and scope<=111 is exactly a true-objective witness; union count below 105 is proxy evidence only.
kill_condition: Stop at the first independently validated target witness, library/packing completion, or 120-second wall budget. Preserve the best state even if it is non-target; do not call a partial union improvement a DTS result.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only if complete and validator-valid

interpretation: Pre-registered valid-row library packing search; no candidate claim is made before execution.
recommended_next_action: If a validator-valid scope-111 state appears, freeze it and perform independent/adversarial verification and provenance review; otherwise close this packing family unless it materially exceeds prior union/depth ceilings.
repetition_justification: This is a distinct row-mask best-response search neighborhood. It keeps each row valid and changes global compatibility by row swaps rather than coordinate perturbation, uniform exact-cover DFS, or pair-conditioned generation.
